[i][color=#93c47d]A brief introduction to the mod...[/color]
[/i]
[color=#6aa84f]Festive pets is a mod that changes your pet to look slightly more festive! It offers a unique style for each breed of pets available! Currently, it only offers styles for the dogs, but I will add the cat styles as quickly as I can![/color]

[color=#c9daf8]﻿﻿﻿•❅──────✧❅✦❅✧──────❅•[/color]

[i][color=#e06666]How it works...[/color]

[/i][color=#cc0000]First, you need SMAPI and Content Patcher installed. Just plop the mod into your Mods folder and choose your settings or add your designs following the guides included in the file![/color]
[color=#c9daf8]
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿•❅──────✧❅✦❅✧──────❅•﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[/color]

[color=#d9ead3][i]Compatibility
[/i][/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]﻿[/color][color=#b6d7a8]The mod isn't compatible with other pet changing mods, so make sure to only use one of the mods at a time![/color]

[color=#c9daf8]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿•❅──────✧❅✦❅✧──────❅•﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[/color]
[color=#dd7e6b]
Thank you for checking out my mod! I hope you will like it!

[/color][color=#dd7e6b]-Izzy (Maple Blossom)[/color][/font]
